MSCI Korea Index (USD) | msci.com
The MSCI Korea Index is designed to measure the performance of the large and mid cap segments of the South Korean market. With 74
constituents, the index covers about 85% of the Korean equity universe .
For a complete description of the index methodology, please see Index methodology - MSCI.
